relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: More recently, the FDA approval of Journavx (Suzetrigine®), a small molecule selective Nav1.8 inhibitor, has established the effectiveness of targeting peripherally located VGSC for pain management.

key_findings: Two novel arachnid toxins (HtsTX-1, PcaTX-2) act as site 3 modulators of Nav1.7, increasing peak current and slowing inactivation.
Both toxins inhibit closed-state inactivation (faster tau) and speed recovery from inactivation without shifting steady-state fast or slow inactivation.
